entities.name: Avestan period
entities.label: Timeframe
entities.summary: The Avestan period is the period of Iranian history when the collection of canonical texts of Zoroastrianism called the Avesta were produced. The period saw important developments to religious thought and to Iranian mythology, historiography and literature exemplified by the Shahnameh.
